title: Pattern matching and functional C#
intro: Pattern matching lets you branch on the shape, type, and value of data instead of writing nested if statements. This module starts with concise expression-bodied members, moves through switch expressions and the full pattern vocabulary, then shows how with expressions keep records immutable — ending with a real auth-provider branching scenario.

conceptCards.title: Expression-bodied members
conceptCards.summary: Use => when a method or property body is a single expression — not a lambda delegate.

conceptCards.title: Switch expressions
conceptCards.summary: Pattern-matching switch that returns a value. First matching arm wins; compiler checks exhaustiveness.

conceptCards.title: Pattern kinds
conceptCards.summary: Declaration, property, relational, list, and logical and/or/not patterns test shape and value.
conceptCards.example: [_, "DEPOSIT", .., var amount] for ragged CSV rows.

conceptCards.title: with and immutability
conceptCards.summary: with copies a record and sets named properties. Original unchanged; copy is shallow.
conceptCards.example: var frozen = policy with { AllowLate = false };

conceptCards.title: LTI and auth branching
conceptCards.summary: Model providers as records; switch on property patterns. Throw on unknown — never default to admin.
